description: A complete simplified E1M1 main route: preserved opening recess and pillars, three zombie encounters, damaging zigzag slime, then the source-aligned narrow passage, flat pre-exit room, one openable passage door and an open final doorway and dedicated west-wall exit switch. All world positions translate north by 160 units without changing geometry scale or gameplay distances. A sealed full-height rectangular structure uses the original first encounter chamber footprint; both sides remain walkable on the unchanged flat floor.

coordinate_system: Unsigned three-byte Q16.8 positions; authored coordinates0..1023, one world unit=8Doom units. +X east, +Z north; angle0 faces+Z,64 faces+X,128 faces-Z. Existing scale and1/256 movement precision preserved.

recess.current_interpretation: Central floor0, surrounding floor2; uniformhalfscale of preserved opening experiment.

source.recessInterpretation: Uniformhalfscale of preserved central recess and four WAD-derived pillars.
simplifications: All logical horizontal/vertical/player dimensions halved together; visual proportions retained.
The first passage uses axis-aligned runs and short bevels to bound collision arithmetic. Exact upper3:7 diagonal retained.
Sector4 door permanently open; no moving door logic.
First encounter room flattened to floor2/ceiling10 and rectangularized to the WAD outer ledge bounds.

Interior chamber8/51/52 sealed at its source outer footprint; its interior steps/ceiling and small platform sectors9..12 omitted; next exit385 was sealed in the baseline and is opened by this extension.
Opening room including its prior simplified alcove/window/stair closures is retained at uniformhalfscale.
Source385 mouth at x232 is adapted to x240,z128..144 to preserve the existing rectangularized encounter.
Small documented right-wall rebevels retain the WAD outline while bounding primitive normals to7 and finite line-distance arithmetic below128.

One active item slot selects health in encounter 0 and ammunition in encounter 1. Looking back while the far room is active hides the uncollected medkit; collected states persist independently across handoffs.
Original slime sectors55/57/61 remain level with the walkway and damaging after a short grace period; inner boundaries are snapped to primitive normals no larger than7.
The former southern cap is opened into source-scaled sectors75/76, pre-exit room72/73/74, vestibule78/80/81 and exit chamber82/83/84.
All horizontal positions translate by +160Z; heights, scale, movement, actor distances and hazard timing are unchanged.
One exit-route door opens on use at floor2/ceiling10; the final doorway stays open; source ceiling/light subdivisions, decorative panels298..303 and side secrets are omitted.
Reverse encounter handoff requires X<=244 and Z>=168; forward handoff is X>=248. Both soldiers use their authored room-confined pursuit bounds.
Exit switch preserves fresh-A activation, prompt, completion chime and Start restart; it now occupies source linedef330 on the chamber west wall.

inner_structure.adaptation: Retains the source chamber outer footprint, sealing its west-facing opening into one opaque rectangular block. No interior room, steps, lowered ceiling, new door or actor is added. The surrounding floor remains level.

portals.adaptation: Moved source mouth from x232 to the preserved encounter wall x240.
Semantic flat-room threshold near source195; no wall or height change.

medkit.location: Encounter room northwest side; left after entering from passage

ammo.location: Dry entrance apron of the zigzag room, forward of the return-wall corner and before the second soldier

encounter_handoff.item_scope: One shared item slot selects the medkit in encounter 0, ammo in encounter 1, and no item in encounter 2. Each pickup retains its independent collected state across handoffs.
encounter_handoff.scope: Activate the second encounter in the first bend, before its relocated soldier can enter view. The first reverse handoff requires Z>=168, so the exit extension cannot reactivate encounter 0. A second Z gate selects encounter 2 near the passage door. All three actors persist independently, with only one active; an outgoing living actor or corpse may disappear at handoff.

third.scope: Activate the third soldier immediately before the Z120 passage door. Returning north to Z136 restores the second encounter. Only one actor renders or simulates at a time; after the door has opened, a living outgoing actor may visibly disappear at this boundary. Closed-door wall occlusion and the room-only sight domain prevent seeing or attacking through the closed panel.

slime.palette: Muted green replaces dark wall brown only in views with displayed green slime; wall and recess brown remap to remaining brown.

validation.cellRule: Entire closed unit cell inside source pool; player center selects cell
validation.footprintRule: Player collision radius is not expanded into the hazard

exit_extension.doors: first passage door opens on use; final exit doorway remains open

door.description: Opaque two-sided panel at the south end of the narrow passage; opening retains the complete accepted route.

balance.rationale: The three soldiers require nine hits in total. Six starting rounds encourage using the ten-round clip for a full clear, leaving seven spare shots when every round is available.
